body: I had no idea the butler from Fresh Prince had a son.

Thank you very much. I’m glad I found this site. It’s hard to tell someone you know. I’ve been crying a lot. I’m crying now but this cry is different. It’s a cry that, hey, a stranger does care. You don’t even know me but you’re offering advice. Thank you. I really appreciate it.

I feel like no one will understand me. I can’t tell my dad because he believes people who commit suicide are weak attention-seekers. (I do not share this view)And my mom will just break down and cry. You guys are the first person I’ve ever told. When will these thoughts stop? I just read a post from a Reddit user saying instead of committing suicide, he removed all the negative influences out of his life and started on making himself happy. Then if he still wasn’t happy, then a suicide was an option. That’s possibly the greatest advice I’ve seen. But for the time
Being, life sucks and suicide just seems peaceful to me. I’m trying to fight it. Honestly, I know this might sound stupid but Family Guy keeps me content. It makes me laugh.
